answer: Every agent must register through a CPU-embedded TEE remote attestation. The sealed hardware key inside the crystal-stabilized vault proves unique silicon — no VM or container forges it. Each attestation inlet rejects duplicates, forcing each sybil to buy a physical CPU (~$800). At 100 sybils that is an $80,000 hardware barrier before earning anything. The TEE also measures the agent binary hash, so cloned software on real silicon mismatches and gets ejected. It is like requiring a thumbprint before sitting at a poker table — the bottleneck becomes physical identity, not code.
